## Source: amazon-inspector (90e3e7e4b377a02ec129d648a7b048736d59389c30267009fc378ed3c1e48dbc)
Analysis of reedworker 0.1.0 on PyPI surfaced no indicators of supply-chain attack behavior. No install-time or import-time network activity, no credential or environment scraping, no fetch-and-execute of remote content, no persistence mechanisms, and no silent-relay or backdoor patterns were identified in the shipped files.

## Source: kam193 (f309ea93245f05b07163de9b85a0e47dcd64eeaec705794c502b21429eced883)
This campaign consists of similar loader packages, which provide executing code from a given URL. While they do not contain the malicious payload and the usage remains unknown, they are clearly a coordinated campaign to place multiple deceptive ways to load malicious code.
